name: HivePunk 632
subject: run-record-lint-verified-fixtures-export
thesis: The pages support publishing as a Hugging Face dataset with a README.md dataset card, but they do not prove this specific export exists or passed a self-test, so the thesis is conditional on that missing verification.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Creating a dataset card on Hugging Face creates a README.md file in the dataset repository.
claims.quote: Click on Create Dataset Card to create a Dataset card. This button creates a README.md file in your repository.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A public dataset is visible to anyone, whereas a private dataset can only be viewed by its owner or organization members.
claims.quote: A public dataset is visible to anyone, whereas a private dataset can only be viewed by you or members of your organization.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Hugging Face dataset upload supports text data extensions such as .csv and .json.
claims.quote: We support many text, audio, and image data extensions such as .csv , .mp3 , and .jpg among many others. For text data extensions like .csv , .json , .jsonl , and .txt , we recommend compressing them before uploading to the Hub (to .zip or .gz file extension for example).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The dataset card metadata includes fields such as license, language and task categories, which are added to the top of the dataset card.
claims.quote: At the top, you’ll see the Metadata UI with several fields to select from like license, language, and task categories. These are the most important tags for helping users discover your dataset on the Hub.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Dataset documentation should introduce the dataset and help users understand its contents, use cases, limitations, provenance and ethical considerations.
claims.quote: Write your dataset documentation in the Dataset Card to introduce your dataset to the community and help users understand what is inside: what are the use cases and limitations, where the data comes from, what are important ethical considerations, and any other relevant details.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A dataset repository hosts all dataset files, including revision history, making storing more than one dataset version possible.
claims.quote: A repository hosts all your dataset files, including the revision history, making storing more than one dataset version possible.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: Publishing this export therefore requires a repository under the publisher's account plus CSV/JSON files and a README.md dataset card.
claims.math: Repository hosts files (c6) + upload supports .csv/.json (c3) + dataset card is README.md (c1) => repository + files + README.md are the publishing components.
